sledge.abilityText: Smashes soft walls, floors, hatches and barricades from close range, silently and with no cooldown.
sledge.tip: Open vertical lines and lines of sight into site. Great for clearing hatches and soft floors above defenders.

thatcher.abilityText: Throwable EMP that disables electronic gadgets in its radius, including Bandit batteries, Kaid claws and Mute jammers.
thatcher.tip: Stay with your hard breacher and clear anti-breach utility on the wall right before the charge goes down.

ash.abilityText: Fires breaching rounds that blow open soft walls, barricades and hatches from a distance.
ash.tip: Fast entry fragger. Use rounds to open lines from range, then take map control early.

thermite.abilityText: Deployable charge that burns a large hole through reinforced walls.
thermite.tip: The classic hard breacher. Drone the wall first and wait for your support to clear electrified or Kaid-protected walls.

twitch.abilityText: Drone that fires shock darts to destroy defender gadgets and lightly damage defenders.
twitch.tip: Clear cameras, Bandit batteries and Mute jammers before the push. Save one drone for the plant.

montagne.abilityText: Extendable ballistic shield that fully covers him when extended.
montagne.tip: Hold angles for your team, escort the planter and gather intel by walking into contested rooms.

glaz.abilityText: Thermal scope that highlights enemies through smoke and at range.
glaz.tip: Hold long sightlines and windows from outside. Pair with smokes for a safe plant.

fuze.abilityText: Placed on a wall or hatch, it fires grenades into the room on the other side.
fuze.tip: Clear gadgets and push defenders off site from a hatch or wall. Never use it near a hostage.

blitz.abilityText: Ballistic shield with flashes built in to blind defenders up close.
blitz.tip: Lead pushes into tight rooms and blind defenders for the teammate behind you.

iq.abilityText: Detects electronic gadgets through walls so you can shoot them out.
iq.tip: Find and destroy Bandit batteries, cameras and traps through walls before the breach.

buck.abilityText: Under-barrel shotgun that breaks soft floors, walls and hatches.
buck.tip: Vertical play: open the floor above site and shoot down on anchors.

blackbeard.abilityText: Deployable bulletproof cover that can be mounted in windows and doorways.
blackbeard.tip: Lock down a window or doorway to hold an angle safely while the team pushes.

capitao.abilityText: Fires micro smoke bolts and asphyxiating bolts that deny areas with fire.
capitao.tip: Burn defenders out of default plant spots and cover your planter with smoke.

hibana.abilityText: Fires explosive pellets that open reinforced walls and hatches from range.
hibana.tip: Hard breacher who can open walls and hatches from a distance. Great on reinforced hatches.

jackal.abilityText: Scans footprints to track a roamer and ping their location to the team.
jackal.tip: Hunt roamers early so the rest of the team can push without flanks.

ying.abilityText: Throwable or placeable flash cluster that blinds everyone in sight.
ying.tip: Flash defenders through doors and hatches right before your entry fragger peeks.

zofia.abilityText: Launcher with impact and concussion grenades; she can also pick herself up once when downed.
zofia.tip: Open lines and clear gadgets with impacts, then concuss anchors for the push.

dokkaebi.abilityText: Hacks defender phones to make them ring and lets her see through their cameras.
dokkaebi.tip: Use the logic bomb to expose roamers and take over defender cameras for intel.

lion.abilityText: Drone scan that reveals any defender who moves during the scan.
lion.tip: Time the scan with your push or plant so anchors must freeze or give away their spot.

finka.abilityText: Boosts the whole team's health, reduces recoil and revives downed teammates.
finka.tip: Pop the surge right before the team executes or to save downed teammates.

maverick.abilityText: Blowtorch that silently cuts small holes through reinforced walls.
maverick.tip: Make murder holes in reinforced walls or quietly cut a wall open when other breachers are denied.

nomad.abilityText: Fires proximity charges that knock enemies down when triggered.
nomad.tip: Watch flanks: put airjabs on doors and windows behind your team.

gridlock.abilityText: Throwable deployer that spreads spike mats which damage and slow defenders.
gridlock.tip: Cover the planter or block rotations and flanks with stingers.

nokk.abilityText: Makes her footsteps silent and hides her from cameras for a short time.
nokk.tip: Flank through cameras unseen and catch anchors from behind.

amaru.abilityText: Grappling hook that pulls her up to windows, hatches and ledges.
amaru.tip: Surprise entries from hatches and upper windows that defenders don't expect.

kali.abilityText: Sniper-launched lance that destroys gadgets on the other side of walls and floors.
kali.tip: Clear anti-breach gadgets for your hard breacher and hold long angles with the sniper.

iana.abilityText: Creates a hologram of herself that she controls to scout and bait shots.
iana.tip: Use the replicator like a drone that can walk into site and draw fire.

ace.abilityText: Throwable charge that opens reinforced walls in several smaller explosions.
ace.tip: Hard breacher who can throw charges from cover. Useful on walls you can't stand next to.

zero.abilityText: Fires cameras through walls that can see both sides and shoot a laser.
zero.tip: Place Argus cameras into site for live intel and to destroy gadgets.

flores.abilityText: Remote-controlled explosive drone that destroys gadgets and damages defenders.
flores.tip: Drive the charge into defender utility or anchors hiding in corners.

osa.abilityText: Transparent bulletproof shield that can be placed in doors or windows or carried.
osa.tip: Set up a safe angle for the planter or hold a doorway with see-through cover.

sens.abilityText: Rolls a device that projects a wall of light to block vision.
sens.tip: Cut sightlines so the team can cross dangerous angles or plant safely.

grim.abilityText: Releases a swarm of bees that reveals defenders standing in the area.
grim.tip: Fire the hive onto common anchor spots to reveal and flush defenders.

brava.abilityText: Drone that hijacks defender gadgets and turns them against their owners.
brava.tip: Take over cameras and defender utility to gain intel and remove denial.

ram.abilityText: Rolling device that destroys soft walls, floors and gadgets in its path.
ram.tip: Open huge soft lines and floors quickly and clear gadgets along the way.

deimos.abilityText: Marks and tracks a defender's position for a short time.
deimos.tip: Hunt a dangerous roamer or anchor while the team pushes elsewhere.

striker.abilityText: Has no unique ability; picks extra secondary gadgets to suit the plan.
striker.tip: Fill any gap in the plan, like extra smokes, claymores or breach charges.

rauora.abilityText: Fires bulletproof panels onto doorways from a distance. A trigger at the top of the door opens or closes the panel.
rauora.tip: Block rotations and doorways around site so defenders can't re-take. Open a panel for your team, close it on theirs.

solid-snake.abilityText: Handheld radar with a minimap of the nearby floor plan that marks enemies and active cameras. Precision mode pinpoints enemies but warns them. He can also pick up gadgets from downed operators.
solid-snake.tip: Take map control early: radar the floor, call out enemies and cameras, and grab gadgets from downed operators.

smoke.abilityText: Remote-detonated canisters that release toxic gas.
smoke.tip: Hold the canisters for the last seconds to deny the defuser plant.

mute.abilityText: Jammers that block drones, remote gadgets and breach charges nearby.
mute.tip: Jam reinforced walls and doorways so drones and charges can't get in.

castle.abilityText: Bulletproof barricades for doors and windows.
castle.tip: Block key entries into site to force attackers to make noise.

pulse.abilityText: Detects heartbeats through walls and floors.
pulse.tip: Find attackers on the floor above or next to site and shoot through.

doc.abilityText: Heals and revives teammates, or himself, from range.
doc.tip: Anchor in site and keep your team alive in the final fight.

rook.abilityText: Armor plates that give extra protection and prevent being downed.
rook.tip: Drop armor for the team at the start of the round, then anchor.

kapkan.abilityText: Explosive tripwires placed in doors and windows.
kapkan.tip: Trap entry doors and windows to punish rushes and give away pushes.

tachanka.abilityText: Fires incendiary grenades that deny areas with fire.
tachanka.tip: Burn plant spots and doorways to delay the attack.

jager.abilityText: Shoots down incoming grenades and projectiles.
jager.tip: Cover site entries and walls to stop flashes, frags and gadgets.

bandit.abilityText: Batteries that electrify reinforced walls and barbed wire.
bandit.tip: Electrify the main breach wall and trick the hard breacher.

frost.abilityText: Hidden bear traps that down attackers who step on them.
frost.tip: Place mats behind doors, under windows and at the bottom of ladders.

valkyrie.abilityText: Throwable sticky cameras for extra intel.
valkyrie.tip: Place cameras covering entries and plant spots that attackers won't find.

caveira.abilityText: Moves silently and can interrogate downed attackers to reveal the team.
caveira.tip: Roam far from site and pick off lone attackers.

echo.abilityText: Ceiling drones that disorient attackers with sonic bursts.
echo.tip: Stay hidden and stop the plant with Yokai bursts.

mira.abilityText: One-way bulletproof windows on reinforced walls.
mira.tip: Give your anchors a safe view of site entries.

lesion.abilityText: Hidden needles that poison and slow attackers.
lesion.tip: Spread mines on flanks and entries to track attacker movement.

ela.abilityText: Sticky concussion mines that disorient attackers.
ela.tip: Aggressive roamer. Mine entries and fight with the concussion advantage.

vigil.abilityText: Hides him from drones and cameras.
vigil.tip: Roam and flank without drones being able to spot you.

maestro.abilityText: Bulletproof turret cameras that fire lasers.
maestro.tip: Watch entries from safety and burn attackers or drones with the lasers.

alibi.abilityText: Holograms of herself that ping attackers who shoot or touch them.
alibi.tip: Bait attackers with decoys and track who touches them.

clash.abilityText: Electrified shield that slows and damages attackers.
clash.tip: Hold hallways and slow the push for teammates to trade.

kaid.abilityText: Electrifies reinforced walls, hatches and barbed wire from range.
kaid.tip: Deny hard breaches on the main walls and hatches.

mozzie.tip: Steal drones and use them as your own cameras.

warden.abilityText: See through smoke and resist flashes.

goyo.abilityText: Shields with incendiary canisters that burst into fire when shot.
goyo.tip: Deny doorways and plant spots with fire.

wamai.abilityText: Catches incoming projectiles and detonates them nearby.
wamai.tip: Turn attacker grenades and gadgets against them.

oryx.abilityText: Charges through soft walls and climbs hatches.
oryx.tip: Roam unpredictably, climbing through hatches and walls.

melusi.abilityText: Devices that slow attackers and make a loud noise.
melusi.tip: Slow pushes through key doors and hallways.

aruni.abilityText: Laser gates that damage attackers and destroy gadgets passing through.
aruni.tip: Gate doorways and windows into site, and punch holes in walls.

thunderbird.abilityText: Stations that heal defenders who stand near them.
thunderbird.tip: Place stations near anchor spots for instant healing.

thorn.abilityText: Proximity charges that explode after a short delay.
thorn.tip: Hide shells in plant spots and entry points.

azami.abilityText: Kunai that create bulletproof foam to seal holes and make cover.
azami.tip: Rebuild opened walls and hatches and create new cover in site.

solis.abilityText: Scans to see attacker electronic gadgets and drones.
solis.tip: Track attacker drones and gadgets to find where they will push.

fenrir.abilityText: Mines that release fear gas to blur attacker vision.
fenrir.tip: Place mines at entry points and trigger them as attackers push.

tubarao.abilityText: Freezes attacker gadgets in the area for a time.
tubarao.tip: Freeze breach charges and drones right before the attack's execute.

sentry.abilityText: Has no unique ability; picks extra secondary gadgets to suit the plan.
sentry.tip: Bring whatever utility the team is missing, such as extra reinforcements or barbed wire.

skopos.abilityText: Controls two robot bodies and switches between them.
skopos.tip: Hold two places at once: one shell anchors while the other roams.

denari.abilityText: Devices placed in line of sight of each other link with a laser that slows and injures attackers who cross it. More devices make a bigger web.
denari.tip: Web the entries to site with lasers, then hold the lines they cover. The Glaive-12 slug shotgun opens sightlines onto your lasers.

noor.abilityText: Shield counter and plant-denial kit. See the video for details.
